components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action of a group: Done, Add habit, Buy.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0 1.2rem; border:1px solid var(--line-2, oklch(0.47 0.05 262)); border-radius:.7rem; background:var(--ink-2, oklch(0.205 0.035 262)); color:var(--ceramic, oklch(0.97 0.008 250)); font:600 .95rem Oxanium, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.03em; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:oklch(0.27 0.045 262); } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.96); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.86 0.19 155); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background:oklch(0.86 0.19 155); border-color:transparent; color:oklch(0.16 0.03 262); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:oklch(0.91 0.19 155); }

components.name: Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as Skip and Cancel.
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0 1.2rem; border:1px solid var(--line-2, oklch(0.47 0.05 262)); border-radius:.7rem; background:var(--ink-2, oklch(0.205 0.035 262)); color:var(--ceramic, oklch(0.97 0.008 250)); font:600 .95rem Oxanium, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.03em; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:oklch(0.27 0.045 262); } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.96); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.86 0.19 155); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Fail Button
components.css: .ds-btn { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; min-height:3rem; padding:0 1.2rem; border:1px solid var(--line-2, oklch(0.47 0.05 262)); border-radius:.7rem; background:var(--ink-2, oklch(0.205 0.035 262)); color:var(--ceramic, oklch(0.97 0.008 250)); font:600 .95rem Oxanium, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.03em; cursor:pointer; transition:transform .15s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn:hover { background:oklch(0.27 0.045 262); } .ds-btn:active { transform:scale(.96); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.86 0.19 155); outline-offset:2px; } .ds-btn-fail { color:oklch(0.72 0.18 25); border-color:oklch(0.72 0.18 25 / .55); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: View switches, categories and radio groups.
components.css: .ds-seg { display:inline-flex; gap:.25rem; padding:.25rem; border:1px solid oklch(0.3 0.04 262); border-radius:.85rem; background:oklch(0.205 0.035 262); } .ds-seg button { min-height:2.5rem; padding:0 1.1rem; border:0; border-radius:.6rem; background:none; color:oklch(0.77 0.03 258); font:600 .95rem Oxanium, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-pressed=true] { background:oklch(0.97 0.008 250); color:oklch(0.16 0.03 262); } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid oklch(0.86 0.19 155); outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Fastener Mark
components.description: One hex nut per slot of a habit: open, done, skipped or failed.
components.css: .ds-hex { display:inline-grid; width:2.75rem; height:2.75rem; padding:.2rem; } .ds-hex svg { width:100%; height:100%; } .ds-hex .hx, .ds-hex .ho { fill:none; stroke:oklch(0.47 0.05 262); stroke-width:2.5; stroke-linejoin:round; } .ds-done .hx { fill:oklch(0.86 0.19 155); stroke:oklch(0.86 0.19 155); } .ds-done .ho { fill:oklch(0.16 0.03 262); stroke:oklch(0.16 0.03 262); } .ds-hex:hover svg { transform:rotate(60deg); transition:transform .55s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: The four sections along the bottom edge.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); border-top:1px solid oklch(0.3 0.04 262); background:oklch(0.16 0.03 262); } .ds-tabs button { position:relative; min-height:4rem; border:0; background:none; color:oklch(0.77 0.03 258); font:600 1rem Oxanium, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.1em; text-transform:uppercase; cursor:pointer; } .ds-tabs button:hover { color:oklch(0.97 0.008 250); } .ds-tabs button[aria-current] { color:oklch(0.86 0.19 155); } .ds-tabs button[aria-current]::before { content:""; position:absolute; top:-1px; left:28%; right:28%; height:3px; background:oklch(0.86 0.19 155); }

narrative.overview: A small robot stands in a cobalt bay while its keeper sorts fasteners on a dark bench beside it. The app is used in the evening, on a tablet in landscape, lights low, pen in hand, so the ground is dark; the bay is the one saturated region and it always holds the robot.
keyCharacteristics: A cobalt field on the left of every screen, with the robot in it; the work sits on ink to its right.
Habits are hex nuts. Done, skipped and failed are states of the same mark everywhere it appears.
Rows and hairlines carry lists. Tiles are reserved for shop parts and calendar days.
Ceramic white, zinc and brass are materials with jobs, not decoration.

rules.name: The Pressable Rule
rules.body: A mint fill means the control is the primary action in its group. A disabled primary loses the mint.

rules.name: The Two Metals Rule
rules.body: Zinc always means bolts and brass always means nuts, in the wallet, on prices and in the scene.

dos: Do keep the robot on screen wherever the pane does not need the full width.
Do show habit state with the fastener mark rather than a new symbol.
Do give every part a catalog number in the `NB-` series.
Do keep touch targets at 2.75rem or more.
donts: Don't add glow or blur to panels, borders or text.
Don't use cobalt as an accent on ink, or mint as decoration.
Don't wrap pane sections in cards.
Don't use grid or squared paper, on the diary page or as a background.
